instruction.text:

instruction.text:

provenance.dimension_basis: OEM RC30 family dimensions, visible lower RC30 principal in source; serial/power revision not readable. Bezel, liner mouth, sheet thickness, latch supports and handle dimensions estimated from source.
provenance.hidden_structure: Sheet thickness, concealed hinge bearings, latch release linkage and unexposed service internals are estimates. No slide rail or counterbalance is claimed for this side-hinged door.

review.method: Actual H264-decoded paired source/output camera and mechanical samples were visually inspected. Complete streams were decoded and counted; visual inspection is sampled, not every frame. Independent source-action and partial-camera reviews are retained.

root_signoff.scope: Visual source reconstruction of principal lower Amana RC30, fixed Tangyuan kitchen stage.
known_limitations: Monocular geometry/camera reconstruction has documented residuals; numeric camera equivalence is not pixel-perfect source matching.
Source blur and occlusion require inferred door timing; late opening9257-9280 and6732-6758 continuation explicitly estimated.
Residual vertical corner differences approximately12-23px in late wide opening and20px at10743/10745; blurred/occluded7569 camera approximately30px uncertainty.
Source people, food, upper/secondary units and source setting are outside accepted principal scope; stage/lighting is fixed.
Sampled surface checks do not represent force simulation; physics not run.

native_projection.method: Inherited verified native projection diagnostic after exact camera/scope array equality and unchanged native camera actions/LCD geometry; not a repeated per-frame native projection test.
native_projection.inheritance_basis: All camera NPZ arrays exactly equal, native camera actions and LCD world geometry loaded unchanged from verified prior native file. Door/lamp keys updated; empty shelf placeholder removed. Projection diagnostic is inherited, not rerun.
native_projection.original_method: bpy_extras world_to_camera_view for native LCD 3D corners versus per-source camera K/matrix used by material homography

limitations: Retained source-frame order and rational frame rate are exact; camera pose, focal depth and occluded geometry remain source-derived approximations. Numeric projection checks do not prove pixel-perfect source reconstruction.
People, food, source background, overlays and secondary microwave models are outside the reconstruction scope. The frozen Tangyuan stage replaces the source setting.
Camera fast-pan/occluded intervals use recorded optical-flow and constrained interpolation; hidden swing6732–6758 and hand-occluded closure timing are estimates.
Only isolated green source LCD glyphs enter a separately editable screen material. Appliance surfaces and moving parts are native Blender geometry.

Concealed hinge bearings, latch release linkage, sheet thickness and unexposed service internals are estimated. Sampled surface-clearance diagnostics are not force simulation or continuous-time collision certification.

Late opening9254-9326 independently fits up to about122.5 degrees, with12-23px vertical corner residual. Continued opening9257-9280 is hidden and interpolated; exact arrival at full opening is not observed. Severely blurred/occluded camera endpoints retain documented uncertainty, including about30px at7569.

source_specific_revision.principal: Lower Amana RC30 legacy-controls microwave in the stacked HDC21/RC30 source; serial/power revision unreadable
source_specific_revision.revision: 按下层 RC30 主机修正较短的右侧内凹按键区、短门把手、金属窗框与穿孔网、连续腔体底板、斜面通风挡板、成型背板和门锁孔；校正源视频开关门时序、快速移镜及近距离腔体视角。

record.assistant_revision: Source630 and5563 control legends: enlarge COMMERCIAL lettering and shift/compact five icon groups to the right of wordmark. Native curve/text graphics retained, no photo panel.

record.hidden_geometry: Latch support x.177 width.008; local shape inferred from source silhouette, not OEM linkage.

record.hidden_local_dimensions: Grip cross-section, bridge depth and fillets estimated from source proportions.
